feed.title: Radar feed
feed.subtitle: Brand-new fakes, caught before anyone was fooled.

finding.title: The evidence
finding.overlay: The circled areas are where the copy matches the real page.
finding.reasonsNote: Every reason below is a fact the site reveals about itself — not a guess.
finding.factsTitle: What the site reveals about itself
finding.tlEnriched: We checked who it is: brand typo, young certificate, foreign form host
finding.tlBlocked: Added to the Guard — blocked on every protected device
finding.tlFiled: Report filed in the Police Portal
finding.reportBody: We pack the evidence — screenshot, proof, and only what the fake site reveals about itself. Never your name, number, or messages.
finding.filedToast: Report filed in the Police Portal.
finding.notFoundBody: It may have been merged into a newer case. Back to the feed.
finding.offlineNote: Offline — this is the saved evidence for this finding.

sweep.title: Sweep
sweep.subtitle: Before the click. Every result checked — official, misleading, or fake.
sweep.emptyBody: Pick a query above, or run your own, and watch each result get its tag before you click.
sweep.emptyQuery: Type a search — a brand, a service, a phrase.
sweep.mapsNote: We can't paint tags inside Google Maps — nobody can. So we check the listing from our side: name, number, website. Copy any listing's number or website into the Checker any time.
sweep.blockedNote: A fake listing is tagged and saved as a finding for investigators — same as a fake website.
sweep.notSureTitle: Saw something not in this list?
sweep.notSureBody: Paste it into the Checker — link, message, or number.

check.title: Check a link or a message
check.subtitle: Paste a website address, a domain, or a suspicious SMS, WhatsApp message or e-mail. Daggers analyses it on the server and records the result for investigators.
check.placeholder: e.g. https://example-login.xyz/verify — or paste the whole message you received
check.hint: Links and domains are checked directly; messages are analysed together with every link inside them. Ctrl+Enter to check.
check.privacy: Every completed check is saved for the Police Portal. Phone numbers, e-mail addresses, Emirates ID, card and IBAN numbers are removed from messages before they are saved.
check.shareBanner: Shared from another app — ready to check.
check.offlineNote: The Daggers service can't be reached. Checks need a connection — nothing is checked on this device.
check.emptyBody: Paste a link or a message above and press Check it.
check.step_engine: Running the intelligence engine (link, domain and message signals)
check.step_verify: Checking the official-source registry and official claims
check.step_store: Saving the finding for the Police Portal
check.savedBody: Investigators can see this exact result in the Police Portal.
check.failTitle: The check could not be completed
check.failNoVerdict: No verdict is shown: a failed check is never treated as safe.
check.notSavedBody: The analysis finished but could NOT be saved to the Police Portal. It is shown below, marked as not saved.
check.fail_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
check.fail_backend_unreachable: The Daggers service can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
check.fail_timeout: The service took too long to answer. Please try again.
check.fail_rate_limited: Too many checks from this connection. Wait a minute and try again.
check.fail_analysis_failed: The analysis could not be completed on the server. Nothing was saved.
check.fail_persist_failed: The analysis finished but could not be saved to the Police Portal.
check.err_empty: Enter a link or paste a message to check.
check.err_too_long: That is too long — the limit is 4,000 characters.
check.err_too_short: The message is too short to analyse.
check.err_unsupported_scheme: Only web links (http/https) can be checked.
check.err_invalid_url: That link could not be read.
check.err_invalid_host: That link has no valid domain name.
check.restoredNote: Restored from your earlier check ({at}). Check it again for a fresh analysis.
check.historyNote: Kept in this browser so they come back after closing it. Personal data in messages was already removed by the server.

portal.title: Reports portal
portal.subtitle: Every report arrives with its evidence. The officer writes the decision — the AI only does the paperwork.
portal.aiNote: It reads the evidence on file. It never decides the verdict — the evidence does.
portal.aiStreamDied: The stream dropped — showing the structured summary instead.
portal.aiEmpty: Click AI Analysis to write the case from the evidence on file.
portal.takedownBody: A draft abuse report for the domain registrar — ready to send.
portal.selectBody: Choose a row to see the evidence and write the case.
portal.emptyTitle: No reports yet — the radar is watching.
portal.emptyBody: Confirmed fakes file themselves. When one lands, it shows up here with its evidence.
portal.zeroPii: This report contains only what the fake site reveals about itself. No user name, number, or messages — ever.
portal.offlineNote: Offline — showing the reports saved on this device. AI and status changes will work when you're back online.
portal.advanceErr: Couldn't change the status — try again.
portal.findingsNote: Every Checker result, investigation, sweep hit and radar finding, newest first.
portal.noFindingsBody: Change the filters, or check a link or message in the Checker.
portal.findingsError: Findings could not be loaded from the server.
portal.aiFailed: The analysis could not be generated. Nothing was substituted — try again.
portal.aiIncomplete: [incomplete — the stream stopped before the end]

guard.title: The Guard
guard.subtitle: Set once. Every app on the phone is covered — Chrome, WhatsApp, Instagram, anything.
guard.stateOnBody: When you tap a fake site, our verdict page opens instead. The scam never loads — not one pixel.
guard.step1Body: Android: Settings → Network → Private DNS. iPhone: Settings → Wi-Fi → (i) → Configure DNS.
guard.step3Body: That's it. The whole family's phones are protected now, and nobody has to think about it again.
guard.honestBody: The block list refreshes every few minutes, and the block page your phone shows is the plain DNS one. A fully branded guard page is version 2.
guard.familyBody: Set the same hostname on the home router and every device in the house is covered — grandparents install nothing.
guard.offlineNote: Offline — showing the last known counters.
guard.countedNote: Counts are real blocks seen by this server (DNS-over-HTTPS and verdict-page visits). Blocks made by NextDNS are shown separately when configured.
guard.statsUnavailable: Guard stats are unavailable right now — the server could not be reached.
guard.nextdns24h: NextDNS reports {n} denylist blocks in the last 24 hours.
guard.syncCooldown: Sync was just run — try again in a moment
guard.syncHint: New fakes sync automatically within seconds.
guard.dotNotConfigured: Private DNS is not configured on this server yet. Set NEXTDNS_PROFILE_ID (or GUARD_DOT_HOSTNAME) and this hostname will appear here.
guard.linksTitle: Addresses for routers, apps and DNS services
guard.noFakesYet: No confirmed fakes on the list yet. Only FAKE (confirmed-malicious) sites are ever listed.
guard.testTitle: Test a domain with Guard + Checker
guard.testBody: Runs the Checker engine on the site and looks it up in the live Guard list. Confirmed fakes are added at once.
guard.testFailed: The test could not run — the server did not answer.
guard.testRateLimited: Too many tests — wait a minute and try again.
guard.testInvalid: That is not a valid domain name.
guard.testOnlyFakes: The Guard blocks only confirmed fakes — warnings and unknown sites are never blocked.
guard.testListedNow: Confirmed fake — added to the Guard just now.
guard.limits_doh_verdict: Blocked sites resolve to the Daggers verdict server. Plain HTTP visits see the branded verdict page; HTTPS visits show a browser certificate warning instead, because no server can hold a valid certificate for a scam domain. Lists update within seconds.
guard.limits_doh: Phones using this DNS-over-HTTPS address get a 'site can't be reached' error for listed fakes. There is no branded page in this mode, and only devices pointed at this server are protected.
guard.limits_nextdns: New fakes are pushed to the NextDNS denylist within seconds (NextDNS allows up to 5,000 entries). Phones show NextDNS's plain block page — a branded page needs the VPS setup.
guard.limits_list_only: No DNS service is connected yet, so nothing is blocked on phones. The block list is published and ready for NextDNS, AdGuard Home or a router — see guard/README.md.

verdictpage.protectNote: The Guard is on for this device. You didn't have to do anything.
verdictpage.unavailable: The verdict could not be loaded — the server did not answer.
verdictpage.notListed: This site is not on the Guard list.
verdictpage.notListedHint: The Guard blocks only confirmed fakes. That does not prove the site is safe — check it to see the full verdict.
verdictpage.lead: The Guard stopped this site before it loaded. It was confirmed as a scam (fake) by Daggers' verdict engine.
verdictpage.parentMatch: Blocked because the whole site {site} is listed.
verdictpage.privacyNote: This page stores nothing about you or your device.

letter.unknownReason: evidence captured by the Daggers radar
letter.template:
To: abuse@registrar.example
Subject: Abuse report — phishing site ({domain})

Dear Abuse Team,

We are reporting the domain {domain} for impersonation and credential theft. The site copies a UAE brand's login experience and forwards what visitors type to a host outside the domain.

Evidence on file:
{reasons}

We ask that you suspend the domain and preserve registration records for law enforcement.

Regards,
Daggers — automated abuse desk

analysis.redacted: Personal data (phone, e-mail, ID, card or IBAN numbers) was removed from the message before saving.
analysis.scan_partial: Partial — some checks could not be completed (see below)
analysis.noSignals: The engine found no scam indicators. That is not proof of safety: an unverified site or message is never labelled safe.
analysis.govNone: No government claim was found, so official sources were not consulted.
analysis.noOfficialEvidence: No retrieved official record covers this claim.
analysis.pre_dont_click: Don't open the link or enter any information on that site.
analysis.pre_dont_reply: Don't reply to the message or call any number in it.
analysis.pre_never_share_codes: Never share one-time codes (OTP), passwords, PINs or card details — no bank or government body asks for them by message.
analysis.pre_dont_pay: Don't pay any fee, fine or charge through a link in a message.
analysis.pre_use_official_channel: Contact the organisation only through its official app, website or phone number that you look up yourself.
analysis.pre_verify_official_source: Check the claim on the official website of the authority before acting on it.
analysis.pre_report_block: Report it and block the sender.
analysis.pre_stay_alert: The domain is an approved official source — still never share codes or passwords.
analysis.pre_unverified_not_safe: Not verified: no scam indicators were found, but that does not prove it is genuine.
analysis.pre_if_shared_contact_bank: If you already shared details or paid, call your bank immediately and report it to the police.
analysis.tagBody_safe: Approved, current official government domain — and no suspicious content found.
analysis.tagBody_warning: Not verified or suspicious. Treat it with caution.
analysis.tagBody_misleading: Contains a claim that official sources contradict or do not confirm.
analysis.tagBody_fake: Strong evidence of fraud, phishing or impersonation.
analysis.tagBody_unknown: Not verified. Treat it with caution.
analysis.tagBody_safe_site: Verified legitimate website (not a government source) — and no suspicious content found.
analysis.historyNote: This finding was re-evaluated after the official registry or the verdict policy changed. Earlier verdicts:
analysis.pre_stay_alert_site: This is the organisation's verified website, not a government site — still never share codes or passwords.
analysis.tagBody_safe_popular: Widely used website worldwide (not a government source) — and no warning signs found.
analysis.pre_stay_alert_popular: This is a well-known website, but scammers also share links on popular sites — never share codes or passwords.
analysis.evidenceNote: Each source, its result and how fresh it is. A source that could not be checked is shown as such — it is never counted as a pass.
analysis.storedResultNote: This input was already checked ({at}); the stored result is shown without a new analysis.
analysis.tagBody_safe_established: Established website (not a government source): old domain, live HTTPS page and no warning signs.
analysis.pre_stay_alert_established: This website has a long, clean history, but that is not a guarantee — never share codes or passwords.
